title: Naming the new soup
explanation: Two examples showed the style, and the rule said to match it without copying. One example gets over-copied, and no rule gets the old names handed back.
ticket: Three playful names for the canteen's new tomato-and-lentil soup, in the same style as its other dishes. No copying the old names.
promptTemplate: Give me three names for our new tomato-and-lentil soup.{first}{second}{rule}

ingredients.label: First example
ingredients.text: Here is one of our dishes: 'Sunny Dal Splash - golden lentils with a squeeze of lemon.'
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants the canteen's style. Your order shows no example of it.

ingredients.label: Second example
ingredients.text: Here is another: 'Rice and Shine - a warm rice bowl with crunchy vegetables.'
ingredients.missingHint: One example is easy to over-copy. Show the assistant a second one.

ingredients.label: The rule
ingredients.text: Match that style: a playful name, a dash, then a short description. Do not reuse these names.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer asked for the same style, with no copying. Your order never says either.

2. Hearty Lentil Soup
3. Classic Tomato Soup
